description: Day 06 benchmark over the two World Bank 'Taking Stock' Vietnam reports (ts-2017-12, ts-2018-06). Written and split BEFORE any retrieval run. Questions are in English (corpus language); question_vi is a Vietnamese translation for the reader only and is not sent to the retriever.
split_method: Fixed by hand before experiments: 15 dev / 5 test. Test covers both editions, both Part I and Part II, and 2 filter questions. Split by question (not by document), because both documents are needed for edition-filter questions; leakage risk: some dev and test questions come from the same report sections (e.g. fiscal paragraphs), so test is not a fully independent topic holdout.
filter_semantics: `filter` is an input the user supplies with the question BEFORE retrieval (e.g. the user says which edition of Taking Stock they are reading). It is never derived from the gold source. Only strategy C applies it; for questions without a filter, C runs unfiltered.

question_types.direct: wording close to the source sentence
question_types.paraphrase: same fact asked with different wording
question_types.condition_exception: answer requires a qualifier, comparison or exception
question_types.metadata_filter: the same indicator is reported with different values in the two editions; the edition filter selects the right one

questions.question: What was the level of Vietnam's gross international reserves at the end of September 2017?

questions.expected_answer: Around US$42 billion, equal to just below three months of imports.

gold.evidence_quote: bringing gross international reserves to around US$ 42 billion
bringing gross international reserves to around US$42 billion at the end of September
